args.code: (() => { const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('button,a')]; const target = btns.find(b => /Tambah Karyawan|\+ Tambah|Export|Import/i.test(b.innerText)); if (!target) return JSON.stringify({found:false, available: btns.map(b=>b.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20)}); target.click(); return JSON.stringify({found:true, clicked: target.innerText.trim().slice(0,60)}); })()
